speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me more about the flank pain—is it on one side or both, and does it radiate anywhere? Also, have you noticed any changes in your urination, such as burning, frequency, or blood in the urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Is the flank pain localized to one side or both, and have you experienced any urinary symptoms like burning, frequency, or blood in your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did the rash appear specifically after starting the amoxicillin, and have you noticed any changes in your urine output or appearance since then? I need to rule out antibiotic-induced interstitial nephritis.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.
